text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOMATED ALERT — spike in 503s for /v1/generate across multiple regions. 5xx rate up 28% over 5m. Paging oncall.
Sam: saw this. I'm on it — pulling up the 503/429 dashboard now (<https://grafana.redwood.example/d/infra/503-429-overview|503/429 dashboard>).
Sam: early look: surge coming from a small set of tenants hitting very large batch requests. downstream GPUs are seeing queued requests and OOM/backpressure.
Priya: Oncall handoff in 10 if I can't stabilize. Sam do you think we should throttle those tenants or drop streaming?
Alex: tagging traffic-shaping playbook steps. We can apply an emergency rate-limit rule at the edge LB: 60rps per tenant and reduce max_concurrency from 16 -> 6 for model-worker pool. That should shed load quickly.
Sam: +1. Also propose disabling streaming (chunked) on /v1/generate for a subset of traffic that has high token churn — streaming seems to amplify connection count.
Jordan: I can push the rate-limit via gateway admin API. Will run command in 2m.
Sam: capture current counts first:
```# sample prometheus query snapshots
sum(rate(http_requests_total{code=503,route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) by (tenant)
```
Sam: tenant list: tenant-a, tenant-x, tenant-legacy. tenant-a is 71% of 503s.
Priya: customer-impact: tiered customers on tenant-a (paid) will see errors. Notifying CS now. Nina please prepare incident blurb for statuspage.
Nina: working on blurb. Draft: "We are investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting generation endpoints. Mitigations underway to restore full service. No data loss expected." Will post after confirmation.
Jordan: applying edge rule now:
```curl -X POST https://admin.gateway.redwood.internal/rules \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"action":"rate_limit","target":"tenant","target_id":"*","limit":60,"window_seconds":1}'
```
Jordan: rule applied. Propagating to regions (us-east/us-west/eu).
deploy-bot: :gear: rollout started for gateway-rule-1785123460 -> 3 regions.
Sam: observability: after rule applied, 503 rate dropped ~45% within the first 30s in us-east. 429s briefly spiked on the gateway as expected — watching that.
Priya: what's the plan for quotas? We could temporarily bump reserved quota for paid tenants to reduce retry storms, or set stricter per-tenant hard limits to prevent retries.
Alex: recommendation: set short-term quota: paid tenants 120k tokens/min, free-tier 10k tokens/min and enable aggressive token-based throttling for unidentified heavy clients. Also disable server-side streaming for the heavy route as an emergency toggle:
```POST /admin/feature-flags/streaming/disable
payload: {"route":"/v1/generate","scope":"tenant-a,tenant-x"}
```
Alex: I can flip streaming off for tenant-a only. That will make clients fall back to non-streaming responses but reduce number of parallel connections.
Sam: go ahead Alex. Marking as mitigation action.
Alex: flipped streaming off for tenant-a and tenant-x. Confirmed via admin UI.
Sam: after both actions (rate-limit + streaming off) 503s down 70% and system latency back within SLO. 429s stabilized and are trending downward.
Priya: great. Let's keep the rule for 30m and then revisit with simulated traffic tests. If stable, we can gradually relax to 120rps.
Jordan: logged mitigation steps in incident ticket #INC-7821 and scheduled a 20m post-mit call at 1785124200.
Nina: statuspage posted: "Mitigation in progress; errors reduced via traffic controls. We will provide updates in 30 minutes." (posted)
Sam: follow-ups: 1) run tenant-specific replay of failing requests in staging to reproduce root cause; 2) add protection in routing to detect unusually large-batch requests and fail-fast; 3) improve dashboard annotation to show mitigation actions inline.
Priya: I'll own #1 with Research/ML to test batch-size regressions. Alex please file a PR for fail-fast routing policy.
Alex: filing PR now: https://git.redwood/infra/edge/pull/458 (WIP).
Sam: thanks. Quick note — we saw one downstream worker log with repeated KV-cache OOMs; include model-serving team on follow-up. @Jordan can you add them to the ticket?
Jordan: added model-serving and storage teams to INC-7821.
Sam: moving to monitoring mode. If anyone sees 503s > 10% of baseline or reappearance of the original pattern, escalate on this thread and we will re-open paging.
Priya: handing off oncall to @Priya (taking over) — Sam stands by as backup. :thumbsup:
Sam: thanks — good job team.
incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation steps recorded: rate-limit edge rule applied (60rps), streaming disabled for tenant-a/x, quotas adjusted. Incident set to "mitigating".
